scope: A measured optimal-alignment fitness contribution for exact admitted Petri nets and frozen synthetic training/held-out traces. Not production integration, BPMN fitness, SplitMiner parity, precision, simplicity, soundness, empirical generalization or whole R4-03 closure.

algorithm.discovery: process_intelligence_rs::discovery::discover; actual process_mining::discovery::case_centric::alphappp::full::alphappp_discover_petri_net; pinned_config unchanged from docs/DISCOVERY_ALPHA.md. Name Alpha+++ always retained.
algorithm.conformance: process_mining::conformance::alignments::{align_variants, align_trace, align_empty_trace, compute_fitness, AlignmentOptions}; conformance::alignments::cost::CostFunction::standard(); PetriNet and EventLogActivityProjection unchanged public API.
algorithm.algorithm: Unchanged upstream optimal synchronous-product alignment with Dijkstra. Complete source paths/hashes in quality-feasibility01.json. No optional token-based-replay feature needed or enabled.

metric.empty_cost: m = optimal cost aligning empty trace against exact net, standard cost = minimum number of visible model moves along a complete execution.
metric.trace_fitness: F(v)=1-c(v)/(len(v)+m); denominator0 ->1 under exact upstream definition.
metric.weighted_log_fitness: 1-sum(f(v)*c(v))/sum(f(v)*(len(v)+m)); denominator0 ->1 upstream policy. All alignments must succeed.
metric.average_trace_fitness: sum(f(v)*F(v))/sum(f(v)); upstream empty log returns0. Report separately from weighted_log_fitness, never conflate.
metric.perfect_fraction: sum(f(v) for c(v)=0)/sum(f(v)); empty log returns0.
metric.verification: Exact integer costs/frequencies/denominators retained. Independent rational calculation compared to reported float absolute tolerance1e-12. Costs exact equality, no tuning. Unknown label cannot synchronize and must incur a log move (plus any missing model activity).
metric.admission_failure: Any required variant or empty-model alignment failure invalidates aggregate: status inconclusive/error with raw reason; never average only completed variants or insert zero metrics.
metric.mined_results_policy: Manual ground-truth-net values below are exact predeclared assertions. Alpha net outcomes are observations, not forced to match ideal ground truth or threshold selected after execution. Report training and diagnostic held-out metrics separately; discrepancies stay visible.

manual_nets.meaning: These are hand-specified executable Petri references, not derived from mined graphs or activity counts. Independent QA must approve minimal-cost arguments before execution: only complete SEQ wordABC, CHOICE wordsABD/ACD, TAU wordAB, AND wordsABCD/ACBD. Used only as small analytic optimal-cost reference cases; no general-language evaluator claim.

Missing C requires and suffices for one model move before join.

training_heldout_designation: A10-A12 training variants intentionally reuse the previously accepted fixed Alpha corpus for provenance. Newly assigned trace IDs and all diagnostic held-out weights/sequences are frozen before this experiment's mining; only training traces enter discovery. Repeated fitting variants are independently designated trace observations, not unseen behavior. Nontraining corrupted sequences test robustness against explicit synthetic reference languages; this is not an independent real-world sample or evidence of empirical generalization. No threshold fitting, model selection or miner parameter changes from held-out results. Verify raw source-log immutability and full projection identities/order/frequencies.
independent_reference_meaning: Unchanged upstream alignment implementation is distinct from the Alpha discovery implementation but resides in the same crate; do not call it an independent external tool replication. Independent QA, not author, validates the four manually authored tiny reference nets and optimal-edit-cost lower/upper arguments and weighted rational arithmetic before run, then verifies exact candidate outputs. A second established conformance executable is not presently available and is not promised. Therefore claim only this named source-pinned/analytically cross-checked experiment, leaving original independent broad quality acceptance open.
